abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.
